# BanffBound

> Travel guides and planning tools for Banff, Lake Louise, Canmore and the nearby Canadian Rockies. Use the source links in each guide for current operations and trip-day decisions. Booking links may be affiliate links.

## Winter planning
- [Winter in Banff](https://banffbound.com/winter/): Search 29 winter planning guides by interest and explore seasonal month-by-month advice.
- [Learn to ski](https://banffbound.com/learn-to-ski/): Compare first-lesson options by learner age, ski or snowboard and format; check ticket/equipment inclusions and save a readiness checklist. Matches are published programme rules, not confirmed places.
- [Ski day planner](https://banffbound.com/ski-day-planner/): Personalise a resort day by experience, base, resort, transport and group. Share selections or print a plan.
- [Resort comparison](https://banffbound.com/sunshine-vs-lake-louise-vs-norquay/): Practical differences among Sunshine, Lake Louise and Norquay.
- [Ski pass calculator](https://banffbound.com/ski-pass-calculator/): Compare user-entered current quotes and confirmed coverage. Contains no live ticket-price feed.
- [Heli-skiing near Banff](https://banffbound.com/blog/banff-heli-skiing/#heli-ski-planner): Compare two BC operator journeys and build questions about transport, overnight stays and equipment. The operator assesses ability and the actual programme.
- [Spring skiing](https://banffbound.com/blog/banff-spring-skiing/): Published resort season plans, actual spring lessons, ability and complete mountain-day choices.
- [Helicopter sightseeing near Banff](https://banffbound.com/blog/banff-helicopter-tours/): Separate scenic flights, named landings and ski days, with actual operator bases and direct enquiry routes.
- [Kananaskis helicopter planning](https://banffbound.com/blog/kananaskis-heli-tours/): Stoney Nakoda departure, current-date enquiries and the complete journey from accommodation.
- [Winter driving](https://banffbound.com/blog/banff-winter-driving/): Route-specific tire guidance, official road reports and transport alternatives.
- [Winter stays](https://banffbound.com/winter-stays/): Filter eight researched hotel and lodge options by base, group and priority. Availability, facilities and final prices require provider confirmation.

- [Winter packing checklist](https://banffbound.com/packing-list/): Month/activity filters, stable item checks, optional local saving, settings-only sharing and printing. Gear links may be affiliate links.
- [Car-free winter planning](https://banffbound.com/car-free-banff/): Correct transit routes, seasonal limitations, base choice and complete resort/return connections.
- [Warm-up alternatives](https://banffbound.com/wellness/): Bathing, heritage, spas and indoor visits, with current closure context and conditional access.

## Wider trip planning
- [Dining finder](https://banffbound.com/eat-and-drink/#dining-finder): Filter 32 venue entries by area and dining format; use selected operator facts, current-source links and clear notices before making a visit depend on them.
- [Golden trip planning](https://banffbound.com/blog/golden-bc-day-trip/): Separate town, resort, Nordic and heli-ski journeys, actual seasons and the complete winter return.
- [Family guide](https://banffbound.com/family-guide/): Filter seasonal ideas by age and outing style; check current operator eligibility and the room layout before booking.
- [Dog-friendly planning](https://banffbound.com/dog-friendly/): Match pet transport, seasonal restrictions, off-leash areas and allocated pet rooms.
- [Events](https://banffbound.com/events/): Filter dated Town calendar copies and check official winter festival programmes; failed retrievals are not an empty calendar.
- [Editable trip builder](https://banffbound.com/trip-builder/): One to seven seasonal days, editable outings, transport checks, local saving and share links. Incoming links preserve an existing saved plan until an explicit edit.
- [Choose an outing](https://banffbound.com/what-to-do-today/): Filter seasonal ideas by base, activity allowance and interests, then open a one-day starting plan. Filters are not an access or safety assessment.
- [Weather and cameras](https://banffbound.com/weather-webcams/): Dated ECCC weather copies, separate provider observation/forecast times and official camera/report links.
- [Weather by month](https://banffbound.com/monthly-weather/): Sourced 1991–2020 BANFF temperature normals and seasonal planning, with no promised crowd levels or cheapest-month claims.
- [Choose a lake day](https://banffbound.com/lakes/): Ten lake plans with area, trip-season and outing filters, specific waterbody rules and the whole return journey.
- [Lake FAQ and science](https://banffbound.com/lake-faq/): Nine sourced answers about glacial colour, ice, swimming, canoes and access; no calendar-based ice verdict.
- [Parking and transport](https://banffbound.com/parking/): Eleven destination plans with season, base, vehicle, party and return questions; no occupancy predictions.
- [Lake shuttle planning](https://banffbound.com/shuttle-reservations/): Distinct reserved Parks, Roam and commercial journeys with actual boarding and return checks.
- [Planning tools](https://banffbound.com/tools/)
- [Icefields Parkway planner](https://banffbound.com/icefields-parkway-planner/): Compare 14 documented places by direction, season and visit type, then copy a selected shortlist and current-source checks. It does not calculate an arrival time.
- [Icefields Parkway stop choices](https://banffbound.com/blog/icefields-parkway-guide/): Distinguish viewpoints, walks, glacier experiences and seasonal services with labelled distance origins.
- [Banff–Jasper journey](https://banffbound.com/blog/banff-to-jasper-drive/): Compare driving and seasonal transport, endpoint or confirmed lodge stays, and current road and recovery sources.
- [Peyto Lake](https://banffbound.com/blog/peyto-lake-guide/): Main lookout, restricted upper accessible approach, longer Bow Summit hike and distinct winter snowshoe route.
- [Lake Minnewanka](https://banffbound.com/blog/lake-minnewanka-guide/): Separate winter shore visits, approach roads, seasonal cruises/rentals, fishing rules and permitted water activities.
- [Banff Gondola visit](https://banffbound.com/blog/banff-gondola-guide/): Summit complex, distinct stair-based boardwalk, transport and actual visitor access needs.
- [Banff Gondola booking](https://banffbound.com/blog/banff-gondola-tickets-guide/): Compare admission and dining arrangements, including separate ordinary restaurant admission and product-specific inclusions.
- [Hotel directory](https://banffbound.com/hotel-directory/)
- [Vacation rentals](https://banffbound.com/vacation-rentals/): Source-reviewed managed-stay examples and imported listing leads; prices, availability and unverified locations are not asserted.
- [Cabin rentals near Banff](https://banffbound.com/blog/banff-cabin-rentals/): Compare six named cabin/chalet categories by area, season and meal plan; summer cabins and winter suites are distinct.
- [The Lodge at Bow Lake](https://banffbound.com/blog/num-ti-jah-lodge/): Current room, meal, season and arrival decisions, with direct operator booking information.
- [Former Num-Ti-Jah Lodge](https://banffbound.com/blog/numtijah-lodge/): Former-name history and a separate Bow Lake day visit, with current access and café context.
- [Jasper park access](https://banffbound.com/blog/jasper-national-park/): Recovery, current closure precedence and named route choices; permission and trip-day conditions are separate.
- [Jasper town](https://banffbound.com/blog/jasper-town/): Base choice, local transit, meals and arrival logistics.
- [Arriving in Jasper, Canada](https://banffbound.com/blog/jasper-canada/): Edmonton, Calgary and rail approaches, with separate Banff–Jasper trip planning.
- [New dining discoveries in Banff](https://banffbound.com/blog/new-places-to-eat-in-banff/): Dated additions/reopenings, separately labelled discoveries and venue-specific booking links.
- [Build a Banff evening](https://banffbound.com/blog/banff-nightlife-guide/): Compare dinner, bowling, pub music, dated performances and dancing, with group-specific checks and a return plan for your base.
- [Live music and shows](https://banffbound.com/blog/banff-live-music/): Use dated operator calendars and distinguish table reservations, tickets and event admission requirements.
- [Drink-offer planning](https://banffbound.com/blog/drink-deals/): Three sourced offer formats with food, admission, holiday and booking conditions; confirm the current operator terms.
- [Accessible Banff](https://banffbound.com/accessible-trails/): Published physical trail profiles, visitor access features, transport and adaptive activity arrangements.
- [Activity planning](https://banffbound.com/activities/): Seasonal activity descriptions, preparation questions and current operator sources.
- [Paddling planning](https://banffbound.com/paddling/): Separate lake, river and guided-trip choices with current watercraft rules.
- [Trail directory](https://banffbound.com/trails/)
- [Interactive trail map](https://banffbound.com/trail-map/): Route descriptions and indicative listing areas; source reports determine current access.
- [Quiet trail planning](https://banffbound.com/quiet-trails/): Selected route plans with season, area and interest filters; no live crowd estimates.
- [Compare trail plans](https://banffbound.com/alternatives/): Different route demands, approaches and seasonal limits; no guaranteed equivalent replacement.
- [Car-free Banff](https://banffbound.com/car-free-banff/)
- [Calgary to Banff](https://banffbound.com/calgary-to-banff/)
- [Conditions and official reports](https://banffbound.com/conditions/): Dated cached snapshots are suppressed when unavailable or stale; they are not a safety clearance or live report.
- [Editorial policy](https://banffbound.com/editorial/)
- [About BanffBound](https://banffbound.com/about/)

## Wildlife planning
- [Wildlife field guide](https://banffbound.com/wildlife/): Nine species, identification features and credited historical educational photographs.
- [Wildlife habitat map](https://banffbound.com/wildlife-tracker/): Ten public visitor-area plans, habitat and seasonal access filters. No live animal locations or measured sighting frequency.
- [Seasonal wildlife preparation](https://banffbound.com/wildlife-calendar/): Month selection with source-based preparation.
- [Wildlife encounters](https://banffbound.com/wildlife-safety/): Behaviour-based encounter guidance and distinct reporting and emergency contacts.
- [Bear-spray planning](https://banffbound.com/bear-spray/): Verified local rental leads, transport rules and preparation.

## Cycling and privacy choices
- [Cycling route planner](https://banffbound.com/biking/): Nine activity-specific route plans with summer/winter, pedal/assisted bicycle, direction and date restrictions. No current-open or surface verdict.
- [Legacy corridor guide](https://banffbound.com/blog/banff-legacy-trail/): Published segment distances, bike choice and a whole return plan.
- [Mountain biking guide](https://banffbound.com/blog/banff-mountain-biking/): Route demands, permitted segments and seasonal restrictions.
- [Spray River route guide](https://banffbound.com/blog/spray-river-trail/): East/West and summer/winter activity distinctions.
- [Privacy choices](https://banffbound.com/privacy/): Optional analytics, advertising and embedded booking content default off until enabled. Native referral links remain available.

## Booking comparisons
- [Compare Banff hotels](https://banffbound.com/book/banff-hotels/): Six source-reviewed Banff hotel fits, location and room priorities, with Expedia booking links.
- [Compare Lake Louise stays](https://banffbound.com/book/lake-louise-stays/): Five village, lakeshore and nearby-road bases with category-specific kitchen and winter choices.
- [Compare Banff winter activities](https://banffbound.com/book/banff-winter-activities/): Three distinct experience formats and verified GetYourGuide product links. Bookings and current terms are handled by the provider.
